stage1.impression: A dim, warm, coherent-looking bar corridor with plausible pendant pools, but it reads as a CG archviz render, not a photograph: heavy denoiser smear everywhere, blotchy puddle-like stool shadows on the floor, smooth stucco-like walls and ceiling with no board-form or fir detail, and a back-bar that reads as a flat grey glass display case. The hero speaker, the red Ember at the far end, is a smudge about 20 x 40 px, half hidden behind the stools. Nothing in the frame says anyone has been here.

blocking_9: The Ember speaker reads at a glance as the hero: silhouette, red tint and light through its acrylic are legible, unobstructed by stools, and cover at least 2-3 % of the frame
No denoiser smear or blotchy shadow patches at 1:1 on the floor, walls or booths at delivery resolution
Board-formed concrete shows formwork grain, tie holes and pour lines, and the fir beams show grain and checks at 1:1
The back-bar's clear acrylic shelves read as thick, polished-edged acrylic holding lit bottles, not as a uniform grey glass case
The booths on the right hold readable tan leather and fir (no large crushed area), with pools of light from their table lamps or candles
Signs of life: glasses with liquid, a coat, a record out of its sleeve, menus that do not read as glowing phones

defects.what: Ember speaker tiny and partly hidden behind the stool line; reads as a red smudge, not a horn loudspeaker
Floor: overlapping disc-shaped stool shadows with soft mottled edges that read as puddles or denoiser blotches
Back-bar: flat neutral grey wash (median 75, RGB 84/73/67) over the shelves; bottles barely visible; reads as a glass display case
White object in the back-bar (Fog speaker in its niche?) reads as a white appliance or washing machine at this scale
Small bluish lit rectangles on the bar top read as phones or tablets, not menus
Ceiling and beams: smooth, smeared, no fir grain or end checks visible; beams barely separate from the ceiling
Booths crushed (crush 19 %) and murky; leather and fir caps unreadable; no table lamps or candles seen lit
Right edge column 22 % crushed; dead black slab in the foreground
Global denoiser smear and painterly texture (proof at scale 0.3 makes it worse); stools look like one repeated CG model
Haze lays a grey veil over the far end and the listening room, flattening the partition and record wall

changes.problem: The hero speaker is about 20 x 40 px, sits behind the stool line and is the smallest thing in the frame.

evidence.measured: lum_median 68, r/g/b medians 91/62/57: barely red; at 6x crop the outline is broken by stool legs and backs

change.to: position [3.0, 2.6, 1.35] (in the aisle, clear of the stool line), target [17.0, 2.9, 1.0], 40 mm, focus on the Ember at about [15.5, 3.0, 0.8], f/4

changes.expected: The Ember and the smoked partition sit near the centre third with no stool crossing them; the speaker covers about 2-3 % of the frame; the bar still leads in from the left edge.

changes.problem: The Ember is too weak through the smoked partition to read as red light through tinted acrylic.

evidence.measured: r_median 91 vs g_median 62; lum_median 68; the glow is a thin outline only

change.setting: on each Ember speaker 4 x area lamps
change.to: 70 W/m2, 2700 K; also the record-wall strip 0.3 -> 0.15 and the record-wall spots 30 -> 20 W so the speaker is the brightest thing back there

changes.expected: The cabinet glows saturated red-amber through its acrylic, with the white batts visible; the speaker is the far end's focal point.

changes.problem: The render is smeared and the floor shows blotchy shadow puddles: undersampled denoising at proof scale.

evidence.measured: at 2x crop the stool shadows are soft disc blobs with mottled interiors; lum_range 86 with p5 16; walls are painterly at 3x

change.to: samples 1024, adaptive 0.01, proof at scale 0.5 or more (denoise on, with albedo and normal passes)

changes.expected: Stool shadows have clean penumbras and the concrete and fir show texture instead of smear.

changes.problem: The back-bar is a flat grey wash, the largest bright area in the frame, and reads as a glass display case.

evidence.measured: lum_median 75, nearly neutral (RGB 84/73/67), clip 0.59 %; bottles barely visible behind the wash

change.from: lit edges 1.5; pendants 3 x spot 700 W, cone 55 deg
change.to: lit edges 0.6; pendants 500 W, cone 40 deg, aimed at the bar top so the back-bar is lit by spill and its edges

changes.expected: Pools of light on the fir bar top, the shelves read as glowing thin lines with lit bottles between them, the background drops to warm dark.

changes.problem: The booths are murky and partly crushed; the tan leather and fir caps are lost.

evidence.measured: lum_median 12.5, crush 19.3 %; the right edge column [620,120,720,480] is 22 % crushed

change.setting: EARF Moon table lamps on the booth tables, candles, sconce
change.from: table lamps not reading in frame; candles 4.5 W; sconce 80 W
change.to: make sure each booth table in view has its lit EARF Moon table lamp and a candle in an amber votive; candles 8 W; sconce 140 W, 2400 K

changes.expected: Small warm pools on each booth table, readable leather tufting and fir caps, deep but not empty shadow between them.

changes.problem: The concrete walls and ceiling and the fir beams read as smooth, smeared CG plaster.

evidence.measured: lum_range 38 across the whole ceiling band, p5 17 / p95 55; no board lines, tie holes or wood grain visible at 3x

change.from: current concrete tone and sheen, fir stain
change.to: concrete: stronger board-form bump (boards about 150 mm, 1.5 mm relief), visible tie-hole grid, faint pour lines, roughness 0.75; fir: darker stain on the end grain, visible checks, roughness 0.6 with a slight sheen so the beams catch the pendant spill

changes.expected: At 1:1 the walls show formwork boards and tie holes and the beams separate from the ceiling with grain and highlight.

changes.problem: There is no sign of life, and the small lit cards on the bar read as phones.

evidence.measured: small bluish-white lit rectangles along the bar top; no glasses, coats or records visible at 3x

change.from: menus that read as lit screens; glasses not visible
change.to: matte warm-white folded menus (or remove them), two rocks glasses with amber liquid and a coupe on the bar in the pendant pools, a coat over one stool, a record out of its sleeve on a booth table

changes.expected: The bar reads as a working room a few minutes before or after service.

changes.problem: The haze lays a grey veil over the far end and flattens the partition and record wall.

evidence.measured: lum_p5 15.5, median 29: lifted blacks behind the chairs; the record wall is a grey blur

changes.expected: Deeper blacks at the far end with the pendant and speaker light still showing a faint atmosphere.

out_of_scope.request: Give the stools varied wear and positions, or a less generic, less repeated model
out_of_scope.why: The stools are part of the room's fixed design. Only their placement as set dressing could change, and that is limited.

out_of_scope.request: Make the Fog speaker in the back-bar niche read less like a white appliance
out_of_scope.why: The product's shape and colour are fixed. Only the niche lighting (niches' frosted backs 0.8, niche spots 200 W) can help, by backlighting it so the clear acrylic reads.
